PGR-1000 Series




PGR-1000 series gear indicators for motorcycles are self-programming.  Simply hook them up, ride through all of the gears and you're done! 

The PGR-1000 series is a universal programmable gear indicator and can be used on nearly any bike with an electronic speed signal (speedometer) and a 12 volt electrical system!

Features include:

  • 1-7 gear readout
  • Neutral indicator
  • Self- Dimming
  • Choice of either Chrome or Black Anodized housing.
  • Choice of either Blue or Red displays.
  • Mounting bracket built in.
  • 2 year warranty

    *Not compatible with any CAN bus model motorcycles
